Explore my CV

The starting point

Present my professional experience in a format accessible through a link and in two languages, with a clear reading experience on desktop and mobile.

How I built it

  • A recognisable structure for the profile, technologies, experience and education.
  • Complete Spanish and English versions, with direct access to each language.
  • Light and dark themes and résumé printing options.
  • Contact details and professional profiles accessible from the document itself.

The result

A public, navigable résumé that complements Alejandro’sTech and brings together the details of my professional experience.
